fields.description: Stored 32-bit checksum word of flash sector 0xC. Computed by FUN_08006a9c over sector-buffer bytes [4..0x1000) as sum = SEED + Σ(byte[i]+i) with SEED = 0, stored as (sum_mod16 << 16) | ((-sum) & 0xFFFF). FUN_08006c94 writes it to buffer[0..4) on store; FUN_08006d90 compares FUN_08006b10's recomputed value against it on load. Baseline value 0xF7FA0806 independently recomputed byte-exact from samples/baseline.sav. Custom algorithm (not in Schema v2 list), so it is a plain u32_le field; see SPEC.md for the recompute recipe.
fields.evidence: FUN_08006a9c accumulates (uint)*(byte*)(buf+iVar2)+iVar2 for iVar2 in [4..limit] into sum/diff pair and returns (sum*0x10000)|(diff&mask); FUN_08006c94 stores the result at sector-buffer[0..4); FUN_08006d90 verifies FUN_08006b10's recomputed value against sector-buffer[0..4); file offset 0xC000 holds 0xF7FA0806 which matches the seed-0 full-sector recomputation exactly.
fields.name: save_checksum_u32

fields.description: Payload word 0: u32 at sector-buffer offset +4 (first word of the game save payload). Bulk-copied between game RAM and the sector buffer by FUN_08006c94 (store) / FUN_08006d90 (load) and covered by the FUN_08006a9c checksum over [4..0x1000). Per-word gameplay semantics are not resolved in this decomp slice (fresh-save payload is all zeros); exposed as a mutable scalar for live-mutation probing. Recompute save_checksum_u32 after mutating (see SPEC.md).
fields.evidence: FUN_08006c94 copies game RAM into sector-buffer+4 and FUN_08006d90 copies sector-buffer+4 out to game RAM; FUN_08006a9c checksums sector-buffer bytes [4..0x1000); sector 0xC is programmed at file 0xC000 in samples/baseline.sav.
fields.name: save_data_word_0

fields.description: Payload word 1: u32 at sector-buffer offset +8. Same bulk-copy and checksum coverage as save_data_word_0; per-word semantics unresolved (reads zero in the fresh baseline save). Mutable scalar for live-mutation probing; recompute save_checksum_u32 after mutating.
fields.evidence: FUN_08006c94 / FUN_08006d90 bulk-copy sector-buffer+4 payload words; FUN_08006a9c covers [4..0x1000); file 0xC008 in samples/baseline.sav reads 0x00000000.

fields.description: Remainder of the game save payload: sector-buffer offsets +24..+4096 (file 0xC018..0xD000), all zeros in the fresh baseline save. Bulk-copied by FUN_08006c94 / FUN_08006d90 and fully covered by the FUN_08006a9c checksum; no per-field structure is resolved for this tail in the decomp slice, so it is kept as one bytes block.
fields.evidence: FUN_08006c94 / FUN_08006d90 copy the payload tail in bulk; FUN_08006a9c checksums every byte of [4..0x1000); file 0xC018..0xD000 is uniformly 0x00 in samples/baseline.sav.
